items.name: Student self-report form / in-app intake
items.tierGroup: TIER A — DECLARED (lowest friction, start here)
items.guidance: Fastest to deploy. Age-appropriate wording. Self-report is honest about preference, weak on ability — never use M1 alone for a skill score.

items.name: Parent / guardian form
items.tierGroup: TIER A — DECLARED (lowest friction, start here)
items.guidance: Mandatory source for anything financial, medical or family-context. The parent is also the consent-giver under DPDP s.9(1).

items.name: Counsellor-led structured interview (WGC)
items.tierGroup: TIER A — DECLARED (lowest friction, start here)
items.guidance: Highest-quality qualitative source. Expensive per student — reserve it for depth, ambiguity, and resolving conflicts between M1 and M2.

items.name: Teacher / school questionnaire
items.tierGroup: TIER A — DECLARED (lowest friction, start here)
items.guidance: Requires a school partnership and school-side consent. Strong for classroom behaviour the platform cannot see.

items.name: Document upload by student / parent
items.tierGroup: TIER B — DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE (verifiable)
items.guidance: Report cards, marksheets, certificates, score reports. Verifiable and defensible; the backbone of the academic record.

items.name: Official school record (transcript, attendance register)
items.tierGroup: TIER B — DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE (verifiable)
items.guidance: Via school MoU. Higher trust than M5 because it is issuer-supplied, not family-supplied.

items.name: Third-party / issuer verification
items.tierGroup: TIER B — DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE (verifiable)
items.guidance: Board portals, olympiad bodies, ETS / British Council, internship employers. Use for anything that will be shown to a university.

items.name: Portfolio artefact upload
items.tierGroup: TIER B — DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE (verifiable)
items.guidance: Projects, essays, code repositories, video, design work. The artefact itself is the evidence.

items.name: Diagnostic / adaptive assessment on platform
items.tierGroup: TIER C — ASSESSMENT & PSYCHOMETRICS (derived scores)
items.guidance: The correct instrument for any 0-100 ability score. Must be blueprinted and item-analysed, not improvised.

items.name: Validated psychometric inventory (licensed, age-normed)
items.tierGroup: TIER C — ASSESSMENT & PSYCHOMETRICS (derived scores)
items.guidance: Use published, adolescent-normed instruments under licence. Do NOT invent personality or anxiety scales in-house.

items.name: Rubric-scored work sample (human rater)
items.tierGroup: TIER C — ASSESSMENT & PSYCHOMETRICS (derived scores)
items.guidance: Double-rate with an inter-rater reliability check. The defensible way to score writing, research depth and project quality.

items.name: Structured viva / mock interview (rubric-scored)
items.tierGroup: TIER C — ASSESSMENT & PSYCHOMETRICS (derived scores)
items.guidance: Best source for speaking, interview and presentation ability.

items.name: In-app learning telemetry (disclosed)
items.tierGroup: TIER D — IN-APP TELEMETRY (disclosed, product-scoped)  [labels reconstructed]
items.guidance: Focus-session duration, interruption events, tab-blur inside the Learnibility app only, session and revision patterns. Disclosed in-product; never device-wide.

items.name: Assessment item-response logs
items.tierGroup: TIER D — IN-APP TELEMETRY (disclosed, product-scoped)  [labels reconstructed]
items.guidance: Item-level timing and error patterns from platform assessments; powers error-type and calibration analytics.

items.name: Planner / goal-tracker events
items.tierGroup: TIER D — IN-APP TELEMETRY (disclosed, product-scoped)  [labels reconstructed]
items.guidance: Tasks set, completed and missed inside the product; the behavioural record behind consistency metrics.

items.name: Derived composite platform score
items.tierGroup: TIER D — IN-APP TELEMETRY (disclosed, product-scoped)  [labels reconstructed]
items.guidance: Computed from other collected inputs. Document the formula and show the student and parent which inputs drove the output.

items.name: Counsellor observation log (structured)
items.tierGroup: TIER E — HUMAN OBSERVATION (structured)  [labels reconstructed]
items.guidance: Longitudinal counsellor notes against a fixed observation frame; role-restricted.

items.name: Teacher / mentor rubric rating
items.tierGroup: TIER E — HUMAN OBSERVATION (structured)  [labels reconstructed]
items.guidance: Periodic structured ratings from school or activity mentors under partnership consent.

items.name: Wearable sleep / steps data (opt-in)
items.tierGroup: TIER F — VOLUNTARY HEALTH DATA (opt-in only)
items.guidance: Opt-in only, and never a scoring input. Sleep and movement context for coaching conversations, not for ranking.

items.name: Clinical documentation (voluntary)
items.tierGroup: TIER F — VOLUNTARY HEALTH DATA (opt-in only)
items.guidance: Accommodations only. Separate encrypted store, excluded from every ranking, retained only while the accommodation is active.
